description: Position du trait de côte du littoral rocheux aquitaine en 2025 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Position of the shoreline of the Aquitaine rocky coastline in 2025. The rib line position does not take protective structures into account. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Position of the Aquitaine rocky coastline coastline in 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte prospectif, littoral_oca, côte rocheuse, littoral aquitain, géomorphologie. The listing shows 2016-07-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
